messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT P1 1: cont-batcher nodes in us-west1 showing sustained host memory > 85% and increased 500s. KV cache occupancy spiked, frequent page-in/page-out activity. Please triage per cont-batcher runbook.

kevin.ops: I'm taking this. Saw a config push ~22m ago that increased batching caps. Pulling logs and config diffs now.

lee-oncall: Confirmed change: defaults bumped in infra-config/cont-batcher.yaml (rev d4f6b2) `max_batch_tokens: 4096 -> 16384`, `max_num_seqs: 32 -> 96`.

mira-runtime: Memory pattern shows a cluster-wide jump ~18m ago. KV cache retention per-request doubled. Paging thrash observed on hosts with >60 concurrent large batches. Also see a new error class: `kv_page_timeouts`.

alesha-sre: Immediate steps: 1) pause rollout of new defaults, 2) set conservative per-host caps, 3) enable request-level early-reject for extremely long seqs, 4) route flagged customers to a low-memory fallback pool.

kevin.ops: Pausing rollout now. Command used: `infractl config freeze cont-batcher --rev d4f6b2`.

deploy-bot: Rollout pause accepted. Current rollout fraction: 35%. Stopping further increments.

lee-oncall: Applying conservative per-host caps to live config:
```
infractl set cont-batcher --host-max-batch-tokens=4096 --host-max-num-seqs=24 --request-timeout-ms=450
```

mira-runtime: After caps applied to ~40% of hosts, those hosts show immediate reduction in KV growth. However, hosts still on updated defaults continue to thrash. Suggest accelerating rollback on those.

kevin.ops: Initiating targeted rollback for hosts with >75% mem. Command: `infractl rollback cont-batcher --targets=hosts-mem>75`.

deploy-bot: Rollback job started. Rolling back in parallel batches of 8 hosts. ETA ~8 minutes.

alesha-sre: Also enabling a temporary eviction policy: `kv.eviction_strategy=aggressive` and `kv.eviction_window_ms=500`. This should free memory faster and reduce page timeouts.

kevin.ops: Applied eviction settings. Observability note: increased eviction will temporarily increase user-level tail latency for requests hitting evicted keys.

sam-cs: Customers flagged: PaperTrailDocs and HelioSearch report higher latency and error spikes. PaperTrailDocs: elevated pages for indexing API; HelioSearch: embedding timeouts. CS message drafted: short description, mitigations, ETA 45-90m, no data corruption.

mira-runtime: Post-eviction metrics: host memory trending down, page-timeouts dropping from 24/min to 6/min on rolled-back hosts. Aggregate 500 rate decreased by 60% after first rollback wave.

lee-oncall: Still seeing a tail where per-batch token counts reach ~25k. Need an upstream guard: reject requests with >12k tokens unless customer explicitly allowed. We should hotpatch router.

kevin.ops: Hotpatching request filter in the API gateway now. Snippet:
```json
{"limit_tokens": 12000, "action": "reject_with_413", "message": "Request exceeds safe token limit; contact support for enablement."}
```

deploy-bot: Gateway hotpatch applied to 100% of edges.

mira-runtime: After gateway filter, new incoming risky requests dropped to near zero. System stabilization observed across all regions.

alesha-sre: Actions for post-incident: 1) revert unsafe defaults in config repo, 2) add CI check preventing combos where max_batch_tokens * max_num_seqs > 1e6, 3) create a canary harness that runs long-seq workloads against any config change, 4) add alert `kv_page_timeouts > 5/min` and `host_mem_percent > 80% for 5m`.

kevin.ops: Reverted rev d4f6b2 in config repo and re-queued safe defaults. Command: `git revert d4f6b2 -m "revert unsafe defaults" && infractl deploy cont-batcher --from=main`.

deploy-bot: Revert deployed.

lee-oncall: Monitoring: 10m post-revert, host mem stable < 60% across cluster, 500s down to baseline. We'll keep the incident open for verification window (60m).

harry-eng: I'll own the CI gating PR and add an integration test that fuzzes batch token * seq combos against a simulated KV cache. Submitting PR this sprint.

mira-runtime: I'll add the eviction tuning and request-level reject behavior as configurable runtime knobs and write unit tests for safe defaults.

alesha-sre: CS messages sent. PaperTrailDocs asked for a post-incident summary; Sam, can you coordinate with them tomorrow on mitigation specifics?

sam-cs: Yep, I'll follow up.

incident-bot: Incident status: P1 -> P2 (mitigations applied; monitoring). Postmortem ticket: /incidents/1999991234/postmortem created.

kevin.ops: Handoff to night oncall @harry-eng. Current status: stable but continue 60m observation. Watch metrics: `kv_eviction_rate`, `kv_page_timeouts`, `host_mem_percent`, `router_reject_rate`.

harry-eng: Ack. I'll keep an eye and escalate if any regression.

alesha-sre: Close notes for postmortem: root cause = unsafe default increase of batching caps leading to KV retention and paging thrash. Immediate mitigations = pause rollout, targeted rollback, host caps, eviction aggressiveness, API-level token rejection. Long-term fixes = CI gates, canary long-seq sim, alerting, and docs for safe default ranges.

lee-oncall: Preparing timeline for postmortem: detection @1999991234, pause @1999991302, rollback @1999991500, stabilized @1999991820.

incident-bot: Incident severity updated: P2 -> P3 after stabilization window complete.

kevin.ops: Thanks team. Posting final incident log and action items to the tracker.
